rule.name: py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data
rule.description: Sensitive data logged in clear text
rule.full_description: A password or other sensitive value is written to a log without masking. In production this would be a serious leak; in unit-test fixtures it is usually a deliberate canary value.

message.text: A password is logged in cleartext on this line.
